name: Korean Quiet Championship 2026

venue.details: 3층 대회의실 (Large conference room on the 3rd floor)

information: # 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다. # 멀티 블라인드: 종목 신청자 중 공인 기록 기준 상위 20명만 참가 가능 # [참관객 제한](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreanQuietChampionship2026#82890-spectator-limit)이 존재합니다. 모든 종목의 결승 라운드에서는 대한민국 국적 참가자를 위해 결승 진출자 정원의 50% 또는 8명 중 적은 수가 우선 배정됩니다. 우선 배정이 적용되는 경우, 이전 라운드에서 결승에 진출할 참가자를 선정할 때 대한민국 국적 참가자를 먼저 선발하며, 이후 남은 자리는 다른 국적 참가자 중 성적이 높은 순서대로 배정됩니다. WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreanQuietChampionship2026#82887-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreanQuietChampionship2026#82886-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ # There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition. # MBLD: Top 20 registrants by official results only. # There is a [Spectator Limit](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreanQuietChampionship2026#82890-spectator-limit). For the final round of every event, 50% of the finalist spots, or up to 8 spots, whichever is fewer, will be reserved for competitors whose nationality is the Republic of Korea. When these reserved spots apply, competitors whose nationality is the Republic of Korea and advance from the previous round will be selected first, followed by the highest-ranked competitors of other nationalities to fill the remaining spots. If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreanQuietChampionship2026#82887-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreanQuietChampionship2026#82886-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request. Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.
